s1.syndrome_frame: a pregnancy of unknown location with rising β-hCG levels and suspicion of ectopic pregnancy
salient_findings: gestational sac with irregular margins and a yolk sac in the anterior isthmic portion of the uterus
fetal pole with cardiac activity in a sac traversing the full width of the anterior myometrium
key_facts: 36-year-old woman with two prior cesarean deliveries and two first-trimester miscarriages
serum quantitative β-hCG was 16,124 mIU/mL at presentation
transabdominal ultrasound did not locate an intrauterine or extrauterine pregnancy
copper intrauterine device had been removed 2 months before her last menstrual period
used one cycle of clomiphene
no chronic illnesses, did not smoke or drink, and was not on medications
blood pressure was 113/70 mmHg, pulse 98 beats/min, and temperature 37.5 °C at presentation
serial β-hCG measurements rose by 33% over 48 hours
transvaginal scan revealed a fetal pole with cardiac activity
postoperatively, she became hypotensive without vaginal bleeding

shortlist.label: Cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy
shortlist.why_kept: transvaginal ultrasound showed a gestational sac with irregular margins and a yolk sac in the anterior isthmic portion of the uterus, consistent with cesarean-section scar ectopic pregnancy

shortlist.label: Interstitial ectopic pregnancy
shortlist.why_kept: serial β-hCG measurements rose by 33% over 48 hours and transvaginal scan revealed a fetal pole with cardiac activity in a sac traversing the full width of the anterior myometrium

shortlist.label: Heterotopic pregnancy
shortlist.why_kept: patient had a history of assisted reproduction with clomiphene and had a copper intrauterine device removed 2 months before her last menstrual period, increasing the risk of heterotopic pregnancy

shortlist.label: Intrauterine pregnancy with placenta accreta
shortlist.why_kept: patient had a history of two prior cesarean deliveries, which increases the risk of placenta accreta

shortlist.label: Cornual ectopic pregnancy
shortlist.why_kept: transvaginal scan revealed a fetal pole with cardiac activity in a sac, and cornual ectopic pregnancy is a possible diagnosis given the patient's symptoms and ultrasound findings

raw.rationale: The patient's history of two prior cesarean deliveries, combined with the ultrasound findings of a gestational sac with irregular margins and a yolk sac in the anterior isthmic portion of the uterus, and the fetal pole with cardiac activity in a sac traversing the full width of the anterior myometrium, are consistent with a cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy.

rejected.label: Interstitial ectopic pregnancy
rejected.why: While possible, the location and ultrasound findings are more suggestive of a cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy.

rejected.label: Heterotopic pregnancy
rejected.why: There is no evidence of an intrauterine pregnancy in addition to the ectopic pregnancy.

rejected.label: Intrauterine pregnancy with placenta accreta
rejected.why: The ultrasound findings and the patient's symptoms are not consistent with an intrauterine pregnancy with placenta accreta.

rejected.label: Cornual ectopic pregnancy
rejected.why: The location of the gestational sac is not consistent with a cornual ectopic pregnancy, which typically occurs in the interstitial portion of the fallopian tube.
